name: Glorious Strike
description: Perform a powerful attack dealing physical area of effect damage.

subskills.name: Glorious Strike
subskills.description: Core of the Glorious Strike subtree.

subskills.name: Radiant Glory
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by glorious strike.

subskills.name: Lance Training
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using glorious strike.

subskills.name: Jousting Master
subskills.description: Increases attack area of effect radius of glorious strike.

subskills.name: Piercing Thrust
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Brutal Knight
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage of glorious strike.

subskills.name: Blood Satiable
subskills.description: Recover a portion of your maximum life when killing monsters.

subskills.name: Heroic Onslaught
subskills.description: Gain a stack of heroic onslaught after killing monsters increasing your damage and armor.

subskills.name: Leave no Survivors
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Sparring Haste
subskills.description: Increases attack speed when using glorious strike.

subskills.name: High Reach
subskills.description: Increases glorious strike attack range when using polearms.

subskills.name: Punisher
subskills.description: Chance on attack to gain increased area of effect radius. Impale targets on hit dealing damage over time.

subskills.name: Unstoppable Piker
subskills.description: Strike with a long narrow hitbox pushing monsters towards the tip on hit. Monsters hit by the tip take increased damage.

subskills.name: Javelin Harbinger
subskills.description: Increases the range of glorious strike significantly. Chance on attack to throw a piercing javelin inflicting bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Valiant Combo
subskills.description: Glorious strike performs a burst of three attacks. The last strike sends a slashing wave knocking monsters back dealing increased damage.

name: Battle Charge
description: Charge towards target location knocking monsters up and dealing arcane damage on impact.

subskills.name: Battle Charge
subskills.description: Core of the Battle Charge subtree.

subskills.name: Battle Charged
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by battle charge.

subskills.name: Arena Glider
subskills.description: Increases the range of battle charge.

subskills.name: Concrete Wall
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by battle charge according to your armor.

subskills.name: Rampaging Assault
subskills.description: Chance to knock monsters up dealing increased damage on hit.

subskills.name: Turtle Armor
subskills.description: Increases damage reduction for a short duration when using battle charge.

subskills.name: Rocket Boots
subskills.description: Increases the speed of battle charge.

subskills.name: Shoulder Slam
subskills.description: Chance to stun targets on hit.

subskills.name: Spear Dasher
subskills.description: Throw lances around you as you charge.

subskills.name: Bluntforce Trauma
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Provoking Arrival
subskills.description: Taunt nearby monsters at the end of your charge.

subskills.name: Bulldozer
subskills.description: Pull monsters infront of you on hit while charging impaling them when hitting terrain.

subskills.name: Hyper Assault
subskills.description: Charge multiple times in high speed at the target area, dealing area of effect damage damage before falling from the sky smashing the ground, knocking monsters up with increased damage.

subskills.name: Ground Slammer
subskills.description: As you charge through monsters, leave the ground quaking for a small duration inflicting elemental break.

subskills.name: Call of the Fallen Heroes
subskills.description: Call upon fallen heroes to charge by your side, dealing increased damage on a larger radius.

name: Commending Banner
description: Place a commending banner on the target location increasing nearby players attack speed and attack rating.

name: Parry
description: Gives you a chance to parry incoming attacks.

name: Crushing Lance
description: Call a crushing lance down from the sky smashing the target location dealing area of effect physical damage.

subskills.name: Crushing Lance
subskills.description: Core of the Crushing Lance subtree.

subskills.name: Sharp Point
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by crushing lance.

subskills.name: Devastating Impact
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius of crushing lance.

subskills.name: Precision Blow
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using crushing lance.

subskills.name: Dormant Javelin
subskills.description: Every third attack with crushing lance is empowered increasing area of effect radius and damage.

subskills.name: Finishing Stagger
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Two for One
subskills.description: Chance to unleash an additional crushing lance from the target to a nearby monster on hit.

subskills.name: Rapidcast Artillery
subskills.description: Increases attack speed when using crushing lance.

subskills.name: Landspike
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage dealt by crushing lance.

subskills.name: Pulverizing Shock
subskills.description: Chance to inflict armor break on hit.

subskills.name: Scorching Quake
subskills.description: Chance on cast to empower crushing lance causing it to echo an additional time inflicting burning on hit.

subskills.name: Annihilating Salvo
subskills.description: Unleash a shockwave of crushing lances towards target location.

subskills.name: Magnetized Glaive
subskills.description: The lance remains on the ground for a short duration frequently pulsating and pulling monsters towards it on hit.

subskills.name: Seismic Perforation
subskills.description: Crushing lance hits the ground with force unleashing shockwaves into all directions.

subskills.name: Marked for Javelinstrike
subskills.description: Throw piercing javelins at monsters hit by crushing lance for a portion of the damage.

name: Lance Thrust
description: Perform a long ranged lance attack piercing monsters in a line dealing physical damage. If the lance comes in contact with a commending banner you get dragged to the banner smashing the ground stunning monsters on impact.

subskills.name: Lance Thrust
subskills.description: Core of the Lance Thrust subtree.

subskills.name: Battle Experienced
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by lance thrust.

subskills.name: Pole Reach
subskills.description: Increases the range of lance thrust.

subskills.name: Heroic Arrival
subskills.description: Increases stun duration and damage when colliding with commending banner.

subskills.name: Punctured Organs
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Tactical Distancing
subskills.description: Knock monsters back on hit dealing increased damage.

subskills.name: Swift Striking
subskills.description: Chance to gain a stack of swift strikes on hit increasing your attack speed and attack rating.

subskills.name: Polearm Expertise
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage dealt by lance thrust when using polearms.

subskills.name: Blood Harvester
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Stab Sequence
subskills.description: Every third attack with lance thrust is empowered increasing range and damage slowing monsters on hit.

subskills.name: Volatile Irontip
subskills.description: Collision with commending banner causes it to explode dealing area of effect damage.

subskills.name: Head Collector
subskills.description: Lance thrust pulls monsters towards you and stuns them on hit.

subskills.name: Legion Exterminator
subskills.description: Unleash a whirl attack with increased area of effect radius. Lance thrust no longer collides with commending banner.

subskills.name: Trust in the Thrust
subskills.description: Unleash a circle of lances thrusting the first target on hit from all directions.

subskills.name: Commend to Onslaught
subskills.description: Unleash additional lance thrusts towards nearby monsters from commending banner on banner impact.

name: Lance Throw
description: When using any of the abilities, you have a chance to throw a piercing lance at a nearby monster dealing physical damage.

name: Armor Crush
description: Battle charge inflicts armor break and lowers monster attack rating on hit.

name: Glory
description: Gain increased attack damage and magic skill damage for a short period.

name: Shield Slam
description: Strike with your shield dealing physical damage based on the defense of your shield.

subskills.name: Shield Slam
subskills.description: Core of the Shield Slam subtree.

subskills.name: Obsidian Shield
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by shield slam.

subskills.name: Gradient Strikes
subskills.description: Increases the attack rating of shield slam.

subskills.name: Concussive Bash
subskills.description: Chance to stun enemies on hit.

subskills.name: Skull Fracture
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned enemies.

subskills.name: Offensive Safeguard
subskills.description: Deal increased damage based on the block rating of your shield.

subskills.name: Field Coverage
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect of shield slam.

subskills.name: Violent Bash
subskills.description: Chance on attack to increase the damage and area of effect radius of shield slam.

subskills.name: Hardening Stance
subskills.description: Chance to increase your damage return on hit for a short duration.

subskills.name: Vanguard
subskills.description: Gain a stack of vanguard on hit increasing your damage reduction for a short duration.

subskills.name: Rogue Shield
subskills.description: Chance to summon an orbiting shield on hit for a short duration.

subskills.name: Groundquake Bulwark
subskills.description: Smash your shield into the ground unleashing an earthquake pulling monsters towards you on hit. Earthquake damage and area of effect radius are increased based on your armor. Shield slam now has a cooldown.

subskills.name: Knight´s Templar
subskills.description: Throw your shield with force causing it to bounce from the ground and terrain.

subskills.name: Thorned Aegis
subskills.description: Chance to gain a stack of thorned aegis on hit. Throw shields at monsters when taking damage while thorned aegis is active.

subskills.name: Captain Tarethiel
subskills.description: Throw your shield with increased size and damage. The shield returns to you after a short duration dealing additional damage. Shield slam now has a cooldown.

name: Taunt
description: Taunt monsters to attack you. Additional points increase the monster amount and duration.

name: Honed Defenses
description: Every time you get hit by a monster attack gain stacks. At maximum stacks unleash a huge area of effect pulse dealing arcane damage to monsters around you. Can also be casted early to consume the stacks.

subskills.name: Honed Defenses
subskills.description: Core of the Honed Defenses subtree.

subskills.name: Fortified Bastion
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by honed defenses.

subskills.name: Lucky Defense
subskills.description: Chance to increase the amount of stacks gained when struck.

subskills.name: Engulfing Wave
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius of honed defenses.

subskills.name: Thorn Surge
subskills.description: Increases damage return per stack of honed defenses.

subskills.name: Deadly Resistance
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by honed defenses based on your armor.

subskills.name: Hold!
subskills.description: Increases the duration of honed defenses.

subskills.name: Optimized Safeguard
subskills.description: Increases the maximum amount of stacks for honed defenses.

subskills.name: Weakening Counter
subskills.description: Chance to inflict arcane break on hit.

subskills.name: Oppresive Countermeasure
subskills.description: Chance to unleash a ground slam on the attacker when struck dealing damage based on honed defenses stacks.

subskills.name: Deflective Fortification
subskills.description: Gain increased damage return per stack of honed defenses decreasing its damage dealt.

subskills.name: Sky Bulwark
subskills.description: Giant bulwarks fall down from the sky on hit dealing increased area of effect damage inflicting elemental break.

subskills.name: Hauling Surge
subskills.description: Pull monsters towards you dealing increased damage and stunning them when reaching maximum stacks of honed defenses.

subskills.name: Risen Guards
subskills.description: Increases the amount of maximum stacks. At maximum stacks honed defenses calls forth a legion of skeleton warriors fighting on your side for a short duration dealing 10% of the damage of honed defenses.

subskills.name: Unstoppable Goliath
subskills.description: Honed defenses no longer causes ground slam at maximum stacks increasing your maximum life, damage return and life replenish for each stack.

name: Knight's Resilience
description: Increases your life and all resistances.

name: Shield Wall
description: Cast a wall of shields around you blocking monster projectiles dealing arcane and physical damage on hit. Hitting an enemy with Shield Wall generates a Honed Defenses stack.

subskills.name: Shield Wall
subskills.description: Core of the Shield Wall subtree.

subskills.name: Spiked Shields
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by shield wall.

subskills.name: Durable Wall
subskills.description: Increases the durability and duration of shield wall.

subskills.name: More Shields!
subskills.description: Increases the amount of shields in shield wall.

subskills.name: Split Reflection
subskills.description: Chance to unleash spikes dealing damage towards the attacker when blocking a projectile.

subskills.name: Defensive Radius
subskills.description: Increases the orbiting radius of shield wall.

subskills.name: Shield Growth
subskills.description: Increases the size of shield wall.

subskills.name: Critical Thorn
subskills.description: Chance to critically hit dealing increased critical strike damage with shield wall.

subskills.name: Noxious Shields
subskills.description: Chance to inflict poisoned on hit.

subskills.name: Breaking Spikes
subskills.description: Chance to inflict arcane break on hit.

subskills.name: Dissolving Corrosion
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to poisoned targets.

subskills.name: Gravitational Aegis
subskills.description: Shield wall orbits in an orbit around you with increased projectile speed and increased amount of shields.

subskills.name: Porkupine Carapace
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleeding on hit with increased bleeding frequency.

subskills.name: Shield Vortex
subskills.description: Unleash a tornado of shields towards target location pulling nearby monsters towards it.

subskills.name: Insatiable Bulwark
subskills.description: Blocking projectiles and attacks buff the shields increasing damage and size.

name: Knight's Vigor
description: Gain increased maximum life and vitality.

name: Counter
description: When active all monster attacks get countered with thrusting lances dealing arcane damage.

subskills.name: Counter
subskills.description: Core of the Counter subtree.

subskills.name: Sharp Vengeance
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by counter.

subskills.name: Vengeful Hit
subskills.description: Chance to critically hit dealing increased critical strike damage.

subskills.name: Double Edge
subskills.description: Chance to throw additional lances when struck.

subskills.name: Rupturing Lance
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Spell Reflection
subskills.description: Counter also reflects non-physical projectiles and attacks dealing a portion of the damage.

subskills.name: Battle Magus
subskills.description: Increases the duration of counter.

subskills.name: Lusting Blood
subskills.description: Chance to replenish a portion of your maximum life on hit.

subskills.name: Stunning Lance
subskills.description: Chance to stun monsters on hit.

subskills.name: Cheap Counter
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Bursting Lances
subskills.description: Chance to throw multiple piercing lances around you when struck.

subskills.name: Insatiable Challenger
subskills.description: Casting counter taunts all nearby monsters inflicting armor break.

subskills.name: Volley Build-up
subskills.description: During its duration counter stores all damage taken. When expiring throw javelins at nearby monsters unleashing the stored damage taken.

subskills.name: Give No Quarter
subskills.description: Counter no longer has a duration but instead frequently drains your life and mana. Counter can be activated and deactivated and no longer has a cooldown.

subskills.name: Versus the World
subskills.description: Counter no longer throws lances at monsters but gives you a chance to block incoming damage reflecting it back to the attacker with intense power.

name: Last Stand
description: Restore yourself to full life and temporarily gain increased magic skill damage and physical damage reduction.
